changelog: License stickiness: activate once, never asked again. Removed the middleware auto-expire that was kicking users out after 36 hours. License worker now only downgrades on definitive Dodo revocation responses (parses multiple response shapes) — network hiccups and ambiguous replies preserve current status. Added silent recovery on /welcome: if a license key is already stored, the app re-verifies it in the background without prompting.
